channel.title: IRS Newsroom — News Releases and Guidance (fixture)
channel.description: Offline fixture modelled on IRS newsroom items. Not live data.

item.title: IR-2026-158: IRS issues Notice 2026-41 providing transitional relief under the Pillar Two CAMT interaction rules
item.description: Notice 2026-41 extends the safe harbor for determining adjusted financial statement income where a taxpayer is subject to a qualified domestic minimum top-up tax, for tax years beginning before January 1, 2027.

item.title: IR-2026-157: Treasury and IRS release final regulations on section 163(j) interest limitation for partnerships
item.description: T.D. 10082 finalizes rules for allocating excess business interest expense among partners and adopts the 11-step allocation with modifications in response to comments.

item.title: IR-2026-155: Interest rates remain the same for the fourth quarter of 2026
item.description: Rev. Rul. 2026-17 announces that overpayment and underpayment rates will remain 7 percent for individuals for the calendar quarter beginning October 1, 2026.

item.title: IR-2026-152: IRS proposes regulations on digital asset broker reporting for decentralized exchanges
item.description: REG-118642-25 would require front-end service providers to file Form 1099-DA for gross proceeds on digital asset sales beginning with transactions in 2028. Comments are due October 15, 2026.

item.title: IR-2026-149: Rev. Proc. 2026-28 updates the list of countries with information exchange agreements for bank deposit interest reporting
item.description: The revenue procedure adds two jurisdictions to the list of countries with which the United States has an automatic exchange relationship for purposes of withholding on nonresident alien deposit interest.

item.title: IR-2026-147: IRS reminds employers of the September 15 deadline for second-quarter employment tax deposits adjustments
item.description: Employers who filed Form 941 with an overpayment should reconcile payroll tax deposits before the deadline to avoid failure-to-deposit penalties.

item.title: IR-2026-144: Treasury, IRS issue guidance on the clean electricity production credit (section 45Y) domestic content bonus
item.description: Notice 2026-38 provides an updated safe harbor table of cost percentages for qualified facilities and energy storage technology placed in service after 2026.

item.title: IR-2026-141: IRS announces tax relief for taxpayers affected by severe storms in Texas
item.description: Individuals and businesses in 14 counties now have until February 2, 2027, to file various federal individual and business tax returns and make tax payments.

item.title: IR-2026-139: Final regulations issued on the corporate alternative minimum tax (CAMT) applicable financial statement definitions
item.description: T.D. 10079 adopts the proposed definitions with changes that simplify the treatment of partnership investments for applicable corporations.

item.title: IR-2026-136: IRS Advisory Council issues mid-year report on transfer pricing documentation burden
item.description: The report recommends aligning section 6662(e) documentation requirements with the OECD master file and local file format to reduce duplicative compliance.
